title.zh: 关联问题导出跨分节共同细化
title.en: Incidence questions yield a common relational refinement

claim.zh: 两侧局部有限且在所声明范围内关系连通，根片段对全部关联问题同测时，所有同测片段对构成共同细化，其两投影覆盖相应范围、保留接合并提升固定一个参与位置的接合。
claim.en: For locally finite, incidence-connected declared scopes with equal root answers, all equally answering fragment pairs form a common refinement whose projections cover those scopes, preserve joins and lift joins fixing one participant.

hypotheses.zh: 两种部分三元接合 J、K，可有不同片段类型；同一六角色移动的有限分支语言。
hypotheses.en: Two partial ternary joining laws J and K, possibly on different fragment types; the same finite branch language over six role movements.

hypotheses.zh: 每个片段／角色只有有限关联接合；两根 Related；两边 ConnectedFrom。
hypotheses.en: Finitely many incident joins per fragment/role; Related roots and ConnectedFrom on both sides.

correspondence.zh: 关联节点均有真实 J 或 K 接合见证；图路径是关系检查，不自动是时间执行。
correspondence.en: Incidence nodes carry actual J or K witnesses; graph paths inspect relations and are not automatically temporal executions.

detail.zh: 由同一接合构造关联模型后复用有限分支恢复。
detail.en: Reuse finite branch recovery after constructing each joining incidence model.

output.zh: 同测为双模拟并匹配后继。
output.en: Test agreement forms a bisimulation and matches successors.

input.zh: locally_finite_image_finite 和 match_incident 接到三位置匹配；related_covers_connected 接到覆盖。
input.en: locally_finite_image_finite and match_incident connect recovery to three-position matching; related_covers_connected supplies coverage.

conditions.zh: 两侧局部有限、相同角色语言和同测根完整保留；无分离／双射假设。
conditions.en: Local finiteness, common role language and equal root answers remain; no separation or bijection premise.

detail.zh: 共同细化语言的真实内容边界。
detail.en: Substantive content boundary of the common-refinement language.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 仅固定一个参与位置；未推出固定两个输入的提升。无引用语言在有局部单位时会退化；不是同一实际来源或普遍本体的证明。
detail.en: Only one participant is fixed; fixed-pair lifting does not follow. The unanchored language collapses for local-unit structures. This proves neither identical actual provenance nor universal ontology.

limitations.zh: 仅固定一个参与位置；未推出固定两个输入的提升。无引用语言在有局部单位时会退化；不是同一实际来源或普遍本体的证明。
limitations.en: Only one participant is fixed; fixed-pair lifting does not follow. The unanchored language collapses for local-unit structures. This proves neither identical actual provenance nor universal ontology.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。根相同、每一片段自根可达的两结合有共同细化：其相同对的结合，两投影为开且覆盖两者，无有限也无判定（Joining.common_refinement）；以外围的假设（局部有限、根通过相同检验）加排中律亦然（Joining.common_refinement_of_em）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two joinings with alike roots, from which every fragment is reached, have a common refinement, the joining of their alike pairs, whose two projections are open and cover both, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.common_refinement); under the periphery's hypotheses, local finiteness and roots passing the same tests, with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.common_refinement_of_em). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.

Re-pointed after reading the change: Granularity.lean, takes as its final section Grains, the module reading it, folded in with declarations, names and statements unchanged; pure forwarders and copies removed where it had them; Joining.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged. The claim is unchanged.
